'''G8-R3''', also known as '''R5-A7''', was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He had the [[R2n Agromech Head|standard head]] of an R5 unit on the versatile body of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]].<ref name="G8-R3">{{CSWECite|I|3-5|G8-R3}}</ref> He was destroyed by a blaster bolt fired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] ships [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends#The Blockade of Naboo|blockading]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] while attempting to repair [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] as it fled the planet.<ref name="SW1" />

==Behind the scenes==
After appearing briefly in {{Film|I}}, this droid was first named in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'' CD-ROM Glossary section.<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> In [[Star Wars Insider 58|''Star Wars Insider'' 58]]{{'s}} [[Ask Lobot|Star Wars Q&A]] section, [[Pablo Hidalgo]] explained that droid names are usually fragments of much longer serial numbers. He uses G8-R3 as an example, speculating that his real name might have been something like "R5-X41238-G8-R3-3124-D2."<ref name="SWI 58" />

Various sources indicate the six droids onboard the Royal Starship were R2-D2, [[R2-B1/Legends|R2-B1]], [[R2-R9/Legends|R2-R9]], [[R2-N3/Legends|R2-N3]], [[R2-M5/Legends|R2-M5]], and G8-R3.<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> A single source, a "[[Set Piece]]" article in [[Star Wars Insider 94|''Star Wars Insider'' 94]], replaces the name of R2 unit R2-M5 with [[R2-D1]], and the name of R5 unit G8-R3 with R5-A7.<ref name="SWI 94">{{InsiderCite|94|Set Piece|Set Piece: Naboo Royal Starship}}</ref>
